title: The coat on the hook
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday, the last digest of 2000. The cover is the chore coat on the shop's hook, empty, the cuff, the button, the stain. No one in it. The owner says where is he. Wood says right here. She says then who's in the coat. He says nobody, for once. She says that's the first time. He says the last, too.

panels.composition: The cover: the chore coat on a brass hook on a doorframe, empty: the frayed cuff, the mismatched button, the ink on the pocket.
